# Video edit: extend a clip with Wan 2.2 14B

Takes the last frame of your clip, resampled to 16 frames per second, renders 1 to 4 more seconds from it with Wan 2.2 I2V A14B, and joins them to your clip, with its sound kept or left out.

## Models

- [umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors): umt5-xxl text encoder, fp8, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/google/umt5-xxl).
- [wan_2.1_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors): Wan 2.1 VAE, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged).
- [wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors): Wan 2.2 I2V A14B, high noise, fp8, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B).
- [wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors): Wan 2.2 I2V A14B, low noise, fp8, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B).
